links.outcome: LLM-judged faithfulness, relevance, comprehensiveness across six RAG corpus configurations for Long COVID questions
links.effect: Corpus combining clinical guidelines with high-quality systematic reviews consistently outperformed narrow single-guideline corpora and large-scale literature databases; no numeric results are given in the text.
links.quote: Our RAG corpus configuration combining clinical guidelines with high-quality systematic reviews consistently outperformed both narrow single-guideline approaches and large-scale literature databases.

unlisted_practices: Comparing curated secondary-review corpora against primary-literature databases for RAG corpus selection
LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of RAG faithfulness, relevance and comprehensiveness

screen.reason: Evaluates different RAG corpus curation strategies (guarding knowledge quality via systematic reviews vs guidelines vs open literature) on LLM clinical QA performance.
